knownAuditFindings.subject: native narrow outline dialog sequential focus
knownAuditFindings.finding: In runner Chrome, forward Tab reaches the document body for one step after the last dialog control before returning to the modal dialog. Outside interactive controls remain inert, Escape closes the modal, and trigger focus is restored.
